configurations.name: tuhoc-api
runtimeArgs: set -euo pipefail; ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; cd "$ROOT/apps/api" && export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://tuhoc:tuhoc@localhost:55433/tuhoc?sslmode=disable}" PORT=8080 CORS_ORIGIN='http://localhost:5173' COOKIE_SECURE=false ADMIN_TOKEN="${ADMIN_TOKEN:-dev-admin-token}" && if [ -f "$ROOT/.env" ]; then export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="$(grep -E '^DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=' "$ROOT/.env" | cut -d= -f2-)"; fi && exec go run ./cmd/api

configurations.name: tuhoc-web
runtimeArgs: set -euo pipefail; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/apps/web" && VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8080 exec bun run dev
